notes.title: New Decorations and More Guests!
notes.content:
Time for an update!!

[h2]New Decorations[/h2]
3 new decorations have been added, they will automatically be unlocked after you've completed a certain number of maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681608/776ceadc2f9509bca4f0d68309d0ac1058d7aa29.png[/img]
[b]Halloween Sign[/b]
Timely 🎃 premium decoration that will light up and flap bat wings 🦇 when on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681608/7e4b2a6b3d1e0556525598137d96af514213e1d0.png[/img]
[b]Monster Rock[/b]
Another premium decoration that will reveal a monstrous face when turned on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681608/339ca3649a91141a569d59af51db94cd98b3a5fc.png[/img]
[b]Regular Rock![/b]
It's a rock. Most of the time and effort of this update went into the description of this decoration.

[h2]More Guests[/h2]
Two new guest variations added. They will randomly show up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681608/bf1f4bc4c66dd628ad09af9dea931adbdba60b91.png[/img]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed Evilbur (the sword) placement issues.
[*]Fixed guest reviews variation. There is a random number that wasn't randomizing so reviews would be similar sometimes. The variable was called "randomnumber" and it wasn't even doing it's job. It's like a plumber whose name is "Plumber" and they didn't plumb.
[*]Shrunk the activation distance of the Trigger Pads so guests wouldn't trigger it without stepping on it.
[*]Fixed guests not turning towards the thing that startled them?
[*]Fixed the colliders of the trees in the woods map.
[/list]

On another note after using the new engine for this game, all the order of events for what things get executed went all wonky. SO it's been super fun to debug when things aren't executing when they are supposed to. A fix was to just add a tiny delay (half a second) so things would play out properly.

[h2]Firework[/h2]
Usually add a firework to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271890/Firework_Simulator/]Firework Simulator[/url] for each game release. Here's the haunted house:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2271890/view/3716092146808442574

Also [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271890/Firework_Simulator/]Firework Simulator[/url] has a demo now so you can try out some of the fireworks.

notes.title: New Guest and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
All right people, time for some fixes AND a new guest design thing.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

Fixed a lot of the problems with guests not seeing or reacting to decorations. Here was the main reason told in brilliant artwork.

Guests react to decorations they can see like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681608/6d24492d65236cc3d129751712ac408b1a8423da.jpg[/img]

BUT the way it was working, the "See point" in purple was sometimes off like so:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681608/6a68294e633d821d8c9a94a94203725ba3857255.jpg[/img]

So it would be blocked by the floor or whatnot. Every decoration was changed so now it should all be centered correctly:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681608/e37f9b94f343a5d4e3ad7903fc4c40cfda50ceaf.jpg[/img]

Other Fixes:
[list]
[*]Vision was sometimes blocked by floors and ceilings which shouldn't have been happening so only walls, some decorations and other guests block vision.
[*]Only solid walls can block vision now. Before doorways would block vision if the guest wasn't in the doorway but now guests will see through doorways regardless of if they are in the doorway or not because the doorways have a bunch of colliders and it could get buggy. Might change this later.
[*]A lot more navigation blocks were added and wall blocks were increased in size. Hopefully this prevents guests going places they shouldn't. If you could report any guest going places they shouldn't shenanigans in the Steam discussions that would be fantastic. 
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Increased trigger reaction radius of all decorations a smidge.
[*]Removed a feature that would double guest fear if decorations were turned on in front of them. It was causing vision problems and was overly complicated.
[/list]

[h2]New Guest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681608/fef70285cc40018daebb6c58f59323c007323ce1.png[/img]

A second version of the guest was added plus a list of different names and sound effects. The names were taken from horror movies and actresses from those movies.

It will randomly choose between guests at the start so you might not see them at first or you'll see them a lot. It's random.


The game will automatically update with fixes. Report any other bugs in the discussion or suggestions.

notes.title: Haunted House Builder is out now!
notes.content:
Haunted House Builder is out with a launch discount. You build a haunted house then open it to spook guests. There's both missions and sandbox levels.

[previewyoutube=ZEX4pC92Pp0;full][/previewyoutube]

Post any bug finds or suggestions in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2626180/discussions/]discussions[/url].

There's a lot of different decorations including ones based on [i]certain [/i]other games:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681608/c5a88b5a1ec281cef656a64cd7930066fc2bbcf5.png[/img]
[b]Capybara Statue[/b]

This is a premium decoration, it will light up when on. Also unlike other decorations this will calm Guests instead of instilling fear upon them which is useful for certain challenges.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2559540/Capybro/

It's from Capybro. This decoration uses the same model geometry from the titular capybara, just had to add a base and put a stone texture on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681608/0693cefa946b3b7d74ef330b53d9b51cc59e4d1d.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnome[/b]

This is a poser decoration so you can pose it in threatening ways.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2419220/Gnome/

It's from Gnome, a spooky game about a gnome. It's the exact same model and was super easy to transfer over and setup which was nice. Gnome is currently on sale. (hint hint wink wink)

[h2]Secret Decoration[/h2]

Also there is a secret decoration that is unlocked via secret ways. Hint: [spoiler] It's in the graveyard area somewhere. [/spoiler]

If you find it, it's a reference to these two games:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145300/The_Game_Store/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992650/Second_Dreamer/

Second Dreamer isn't out yet but it's a sequel to The Game Store which might be in a [i]certain sale[/i] coming up in a few days. (HINT HINT WINK WINK)

Also make a firework for each game release in Firework Simulator:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271890/Firework_Simulator/

The Haunted House firework should be in there soon. This is what the model looks like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681608/8dc18b5c76a956f60c6f6e1a6928c2260482bb16.png[/img]

[h1]DEVELOPMENT STUFF:[/h1]

First time making a builder type game, it was programmed from the ground up.  Guests have their unique behaviors and will leave different reviews based on their experience. The Decorations have their own themes, stats and interactions and affect guests in various ways. The save system was one of the hardest parts having to keep track of each levels different decoration setups and how they were connected to each other.

There is currently no limit to decorations which can be placed in an area which might not work out? Let's see?!

Have different Guests planned, they should be in eventually. Their graphics and sound effects are already done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681608/9e4e6484c83cd089175e3b34c5f22bdfbf2ee16a.png[/img]

[h2]Socials[/h2]

Posting game development stuff on these -

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2MxF-3onC1D-30z8lmd8nA]Youtube[/url]

[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@echomune]Tiktok[/url]

[url=https://www.instagram.com/echomune/]Instagram[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/echomune]Twitter/X[/url]

Next game currently in the making has the best title. Will be posting a lot of dev videos on that because it also has the best character in addition to the best title.

[h2]Also[/h2]

Also there's a decoration that's just letters. Don't spell out stupid stuff ok.
